recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-7851; changing clinicalStatus to PRB-13 would undo the FHIR-7581 split-state interpretation and conflict with later FHIR-12988 context retaining PRB-14.
issue_request: FHIR-7851 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care request for the DSTU1 Condition resource. It originally questioned the HL7 v2 mapping for Condition.clinicalStatus, proposing PRB-13 instead of PRB-14, but the decisive Jira comment after FHIR-7581 split the old status concept says verificationStatus maps to PRB-13 and clinicalStatus maps to PRB-14.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit 80c713db6273e0fea9b46a4890014f59a01856de, whose message explicitly includes #7851. That commit updated the then-authoritative Condition spreadsheet so the split verificationStatus carried PRB-13 while clinicalStatus carried the lifecycle mapping PRB-14 / DG1-6.
additional_context: FHIR-7581 is the tightly related Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that split Condition status into verificationStatus and clinicalStatus. Later FHIR-12988 removed DG1-6 from Condition.clinicalStatus while explicitly keeping PRB-14, and that later issue is already represented on the combined branch. Condition is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini, and community searches found no relevant human discussion or work-group record conflicting with the Jira/source/git conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active Condition StructureDefinition already reflects the correct post-split mapping state for FHIR-7851: clinicalStatus maps to PRB-14, while verificationStatus maps to PRB-13.

related_jiras.note: Split Condition clinical status into verificationStatus and clinicalStatus, making FHIR-7851 apply as PRB-13 for verificationStatus and PRB-14 for clinicalStatus.
